design_rule: Approved palette and typography; Playfair Display + Nunito; warm cream surfaces, dark plum text, restrained pink actions.
Compact panoramic kingdom header, actionable Now/Next/Later, priorities, quick capture; no duplicated calendar or ticker panels.
Beautiful uncluttered starter world; meaningful additive progression; fixed decorative slots and growth stages.
Calendar is source-of-truth, week/day/month, clear event labels, read-only iCal until secure user connections exist.
Starter garden, calm growth cues, progress from existing activity; no repeated manual tracking.
Compact cozy header, readable writing area, autosave, text-only archive, privacy first.
Actionable research and brief cards, one watchlist, no duplicate prices, timestamp and source metadata.
Goals, projects, personal progress and optional life modules, without copying the Today view.
Themes, companions, owned decoration inventory, locked shop items, preview and placement slots.
Compact text-first inbox, filters, deduplication, source actions and quiet Kingdom Moments.
Five skippable stages, only working connections, secure per-user accounts and a replayable tour.
Shorter scenery, quick capture, five or fewer bottom nav items, diary archive without thumbnails.
Buttons, cards, modal, loading/empty/error, contrast, touch targets and reduced motion.
